name: Harbor Ledger
description: Recover a disputed commercial ledger from Portside. Patience limits suspicion; bold terms advance faster but expose the crew.

stages.name: Entry: a narrow welcome
stages.description: A dock steward wants assurance before opening the meeting. Choose how much attention to invite.

choices.label: Pay for an introduction
choices.description: Spend cash for a stronger welcome and modest suspicion.

choices.label: Wait for quiet terms
choices.description: More energy, less attention. A setback still leaves a way forward.

choices.label: Assert your claim
choices.description: A larger advance if it holds; public attention compounds.

stages.name: Objective: conflicting accounts
stages.description: The ledger's custodians disagree. Your specialist can reconcile the claim, or you can press a faster settlement.

choices.label: Back the specialist
choices.description: Fund a careful review. This offers the strongest terms.

choices.label: Take another pass
choices.description: Use patience to recover the claim without extra cash.

choices.label: Demand a settlement
choices.description: Greater progress carries greater suspicion and crew risk.

stages.name: Extraction: the last promise
stages.description: The harbor network expects a final commitment. Finish cleanly before accumulated suspicion closes the deal.

choices.label: Guarantee their share
choices.description: Pay for a quiet conclusion and a small suspicion reduction.

choices.label: Wait for a quiet departure
choices.description: Spend energy for a controlled finish without an extra payment.

choices.label: Close the terms now
choices.description: A fast finish risks exposing a fragile agreement.

name: Velvet Exchange
description: Win back a valuable private collection at the Strip's closed exchange. Good introductions and careful extraction matter as much as the objective.

stages.name: Entry: the guest list
stages.description: The host recognizes influence, but the room watches every new arrival.

choices.label: Secure a sponsor
choices.description: Pay for a credible introduction and restrained exposure.

choices.label: Read the room
choices.description: Use time and composure to avoid a costly promise.

choices.label: Make your standing clear
choices.description: A confident entrance advances farther but draws attention.

stages.name: Objective: the disputed collection
stages.description: Two patrons claim the collection. Its value depends on which account the room accepts.

choices.label: Fund an arbitration
choices.description: Cash buys time for a sounder agreement.

choices.label: Build the account carefully
choices.description: Patient reasoning costs energy and keeps the room calm.

choices.label: Call their bluff
choices.description: A large advance if correct; doubt adds substantial suspicion.

stages.name: Extraction: a private conclusion
stages.description: The exit agreement must survive the room's accumulated doubts.

choices.label: Pay the final assurance
choices.description: A reliable conclusion reduces suspicion.

choices.label: Leave on patient terms
choices.description: Spend energy to finish without a new obligation.

choices.label: Close before doubts spread
choices.description: Progress comes quickly, with a significant exposure risk.

name: Foundry Reserve
description: Negotiate control of a contested industrial reserve. The Red Foundry tests every stage; secure supply and a rested crew improve the terms.

stages.name: Entry: a workers' hearing
stages.description: The industrial council asks why your organization should be trusted with the reserve.

choices.label: Place funds in escrow
choices.description: A funded commitment increases confidence at a clear price.

choices.label: Hear their conditions
choices.description: Invest energy in a patient opening.

choices.label: Demand recognition
choices.description: An ambitious opening makes a larger advance and louder opposition.

stages.name: Objective: a divided council
stages.description: The reserve's terms split the council. Keep your crew composed while settling the claim.

choices.label: Fund a shared settlement
choices.description: Cover the gap to improve the chance of an agreement.

choices.label: Hold a patient position
choices.description: A measured commitment saves money but costs energy.

choices.label: Insist on the claim
choices.description: A faster result risks conflict and heavy exposure.

stages.name: Extraction: the reserve transfer
stages.description: The final transfer succeeds only if your progress outweighs the council's suspicion.

choices.label: Underwrite the transfer
choices.description: Pay for certainty and reduce lingering suspicion.

choices.label: Allow time for agreement
choices.description: Use energy for a quieter final commitment.

choices.label: Conclude immediately
choices.description: A rapid conclusion draws attention to every earlier weakness.
